scope: Managed core patch retirement audit after N.E.K.O c3fc33ff promotion candidate
method: Replay all 10 managed patches from clean upstream.
Inspect conflicts as semantic overlap candidates rather than automatically preserving or deleting patches.
Run upstream-owned new correctness tests plus XiaoYu acceptance after rebasing.
Retire only responsibilities that upstream now provides equivalently.

0001-proactive-autostart-idle-gate.patch.reason: No upstream equivalent for internal proactive activity-authority ordering.

0002-full-chat-native-voice-entry.patch.reason: Native voice runtime remains reused; Full Chat UI bridge still required.

0003-qwen38-server-vad-reliability.patch.reason: No upstream equivalent for the Qwen3.8 server-VAD selection/reliability gap.

0004-native-ingress-activity-before-back.reason: No upstream equivalent for publishing user activity before the backpressured audio worker.

0005-latest-character-switch-intent-repl.reason: No upstream equivalent for latest character-switch intent replay.

0006-private-speech-output-gate.patch.reason: Whole-reply private quiet admission is still not upstream-native. Upstream c3 adds stronger turn ownership/lifecycle semantics, so the old recovery return-value break was retired and replaced by explicit gate-aware lifecycle-only turn end. Patch responsibility remains, implementation shrinks/aligns with upstream.

0007-private-first-round-tool-route.patc.reason: No upstream synchronous per-turn first-round private tool arbitration equivalent.

0008-qwen-clone-provider-routing.patch.reason: No upstream equivalent for paired target-model-bound Qwen clone bundle/routing and shared speech-rate authority.

0009-proactive-interruptibility-gate.pat.reason: Upstream PR-14 structurally moved system snapshot handling, allowing one obsolete relocation hunk to be retired. It still does not provide Windows QUNS busy/fullscreen/presentation authority, XiaoYu final-delivery latest-state veto, leisure-only invite policy or interruptibility shadow observation.

0010-startup-event-loop-responsiveness.p.reason: c3 clean frontend startup now meets the tested acceptance, but the patch still covers multiple uncovered blocking boundaries and remains regression-tested in the patched candidate. No full native equivalence was established.
